critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py:960 — idempotency_key `f"incident-{body.scent_id}-{ts[:16]}"` slices a datetime, not a string; will TypeError if this branch is ever exercised with a live push key. Currently push failures are caught and logged as non-blocking, so functional path is safe; recommend `ts.isoformat()[:16]` before slice.

/app/frontend/app/patrol/scent/[id].tsx:116 — incident-share-family button correctly toggles label between 'Ask my family for help' / 'Sharing…' / 'Shared with family — update' based on sharing/shared state. Verified.

/app/frontend/app/family/incident/[id].tsx — read-only guardian view renders headline, progress, steps and event rows in order; resolved pill replaces progress pill when resolved. Verified end-to-end.
/app/frontend/app/digest.tsx:60 — digest-incidents-summary text matches spec exactly ('N incident(s): X handled, Y still open.'). Verified 1/0 → 1/0 after resolve.
